agents.drug_class_hint: boron-10 carrier for boron neutron capture therapy (boronophenylalanine, BPA; DMX-101; INN borofalan (10B)); activated by neutron irradiation device DM-BNCT

coder_notes: BNCT: the boron carrier boronophenylalanine (DMX-101) is given at a fixed dose with neutron irradiation (DM-BNCT device) at escalating radiation doses; coded as a device-dependent candidate (C12). Regimen coded monotherapy treating the neutron beam as the activating device (as for light in PDT); could alternatively be combination with radiotherapy. Active moiety given as INN borofalan (record says boronophenylalanine/BPA/DMX-101); not a radiopharmaceutical itself (non-radioactive 10B). PK planned; the record mentions BPA blood concentration for irradiation planning but does not state the PK sample type for the outcomes -> unclear. IDH and 1p/19q appear only as WHO 2021 diagnostic categories (several types allowed), not as entry requirements, so no biomarker rows. Arm labels taken as 'Group 1/2/3' (text before the first colon). Mixed high-grade glioma for Phase I; Phase IIa restricted to glioblastoma.
